title: The d8 lens protocol as a mountable RIB domain (2026-08-11)
note: Each d8 lens is a frontier instruction the k8s swarm worker should inherit via rib_bus.inject_for. The lens rides down to the dumb worker through the bus, aligned with our memory. Loaded via rib_bus.mount('territory').

e95fbb2c71d0a5e3.invariant: brute lens: exhaustively enumerate all candidates and verify (correct but costly). Dispatch the full search space to the swarm; correctness over speed.

8c1a44d6b7f2e0aa.invariant: divide lens: split the problem into independent sub-seams and shade each. The territory chain = the sub-seams to collapse toward the goal.

a1f3c8e94d20b6f7.invariant: greedy lens: take the locally-optimal seam step each frame and iterate. Advance one territory at a time, always the steepest descent toward the goal.

b4e6d2f09c15a7b8.invariant: reframe lens (kobayashi-maru): change the conditions of the test, not add force. When the territory is unwinnable as-given, reprogram the frame.

d3a5e7c19b42f0d6.invariant: reduce lens: reduce to a known-solved invariant / prior lens_chain answer; do not re-derive what was already told. Cache-affinity: reuse the deterministic prefix.

f2c4a6b8e01d39e5.invariant: seam_hunt lens: spend frontier ONLY at the seams where agents disagree (cheap everywhere else). The k8s render farm shades only the divergences — pennies.

5a7c9e1b3d0f2a44.invariant: evolve lens: deterministic mutations across the flock, keep the winners (survival of the seams). Selection pressure toward the goal coordinate.

6b8d0f2a4c6e81b5.invariant: synthesize lens: merge the strongest partial answers into one grounded synthesis (evidence-lit). Combine the seam solutions into the collapse.

b38f7324577c469e.invariant: GATED FREE COMPOUNDING: keep the free path; fire planning mode on size/ambiguity/expense/irreversible; small tasks skip; plan object = relational contract (SubtleMemory-style evals score it later); router economics apply after the plan names seat/budget. Planning mode is simultaneously plant (Bernays) and brake (Ellul) — wire as cheap local clarify->plan->nod->dispatch, not as a new commander. Tesuji: n_planning_mode is the re-weight vertex touching every cold edge. Free compounding is real AND produces shadow; the gate gates, it does not abolish.

5b596772e11433d2.invariant: THE COLDEST POINT IS THE WITHHELD CONNECTION (cross-modal invariant, arc x map): in every topology - time (narrative arc) or space (game map) - the highest-leverage element is where a knot has NOT been placed; everything depends on it, nothing connects it, and placing the knot re-weights the whole downstream. The arc pivot and the map frontier are the same object viewed twice. This is the planning gate (n_planning_mode, mag/plan.py) made explicit: the gate sits where the knot is withheld and places it at the coldest point. Divergence preserved: meaning-lens (Jung/Campbell) vs technique-lens (Ellul/Bernays) - the gate connects, never abolishes.
5b596772e11433d2.source: me cross-modal lens synthesis (arc x map) via our lens surfaces, operator !steal 2026-08-12

mount: rib_bus.mount('territory') auto-loads the 8 d8 lenses into any fresh worker/seat; territory_solver dispatches seams through rib_bus.inject_for so each k8s worker inherits its lens + map coordinate.
